_comment: Where the festival calendar is read from.
SEASON ORDER. The table encodes each date as `data-sort-value="310"` —
season 3, day 10. The digit is an index into this list, not a name, so the
mapping has to be written down somewhere. Here, rather than in the parser,
because it is a fact about the wiki's convention and not about parsing.
TEN FESTIVALS, FOUR IMPLEMENTED. The page marks the other six with an
asterisk and a `{{Spoiler}}` wrapper: they exist in the game files but do not
fire in game. They are still extracted — 'the Halloween Festival is datamined
content, not a live event' is a fact worth carrying, and dropping the rows
would make it look like nobody had checked.
The page is stamped v0-14-0, which is well before 1.0. Anything it says about
what is implemented gets a `predates_1_0` gap on the record.
_contest_items: Two festivals have a contest collectible: an item gathered in the days
before the festival, ranked on the day, deciding your placing. Both are
stated on the festival's own page (Spring Festival: Celine opens gathering
on Spring 14 and the day ranks the haul; Harvest Festival: Reina opens it
on Fall 7 and collects the berries on the morning of the 10th). It is not
a stall currency — both pages price every stall line in tesserae, and the
game's stock tables state no price at all. The other two implemented
festivals have no collectible, which is why they are absent rather than
Item DISPLAY names, resolved to ids by the build like every other reference.
